_comment: Missions are data, not code. 'in_selector': false keeps a mission in the schema without showing it (e.g. Moon Base). Constraints are facts about the mission; whether each one is used as a hard filter is set by 'hard_filter'.

missions.name: Artemis IV

when.note: Team doc: Artemis IV (2028), south pole landing. Artemis III (2027) is now an Earth-orbit test.

missions.summary: First crewed landing near the lunar south pole. NASA lists nine candidate regions, unordered.
missions.banner: Candidate regions are from NASA's Oct 2024 list, made when Artemis III was still the landing mission. Every region is marked VERIFY.

constraints.note: The HLS landing slope limit is NOT in the team documents. No slope filter is applied until it is.
Astronauts may walk up to 2 km from the lander over slopes up to 20° (from the de Gerlache Rim 2 study). Shown for context, not used as a filter.

missions.name: SkyFall

when.note: Package: 'a 2028 launch'; the backflip trajectory takes ~2 years, arrival in northern spring (Ls ~35°). Landing site not yet selected: Landing Site Workshop 1 is virtual, 9–10 Feb 2027; LSW2 TBD (likely spring 2027).

missions.summary: Three helicopters will study terrain, underground ice, temperature, wind and radiation in the northern mid-latitudes.
missions.banner: Landing site NOT selected yet. First Landing Site Workshop: 9–10 Feb 2027. AP-105 is a design reference ellipse, not a chosen site.

constraints.package_text: V.a: southern limit between the equator and 20°N (TBD, depends on arrival season and SR-1 capabilities); northern limit 45°N. For the workshops, presume 0–45°N is accessible.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.
constraints.note: Mars-only constraint; not applied to Earth sites.
Mars-only constraint (thick enough atmosphere for entry). Earth elevation is not comparable, so it is not applied to Earth sites.
constraints.package_text: V.b: site elevation < −3 km with respect to the MOLA geoid (enough atmosphere for EDL). Not marked TBD.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

constraints.scale: ~200 m on both sides (NASA: <5°–15° TBD at 100 m; <15° at 1–5 m)
constraints.note: COARSE-SCALE SCREENING (~200 m), not a landing-safety proof. Applied to Earth slope on a 200 m grid, the same grid used for the Mars DEM. NASA's limits are set at 100 m (<5°–15°, TBD) and at 1–5 m (<15°, HiRISE/CTX DTMs), where slopes are usually steeper; this screen uses the loosest value, 15°.
constraints.label: coarse-scale screening (~200 m)
constraints.package_text: V.e: 100 m length scale slopes <5°–15° (TBD) to avoid radar spoofing during descent; 1–5 m length scale slopes <15° for landing stability. The 100 m limit (closest to this ~200 m screen) is the TBD one; this screen uses its upper bound, 15°.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

constraints.note: Not applied to Earth sites: no Earth dataset gives rock cover in % (only uncalibrated texture proxies). Applying it would make every Earth site 'Cannot be evaluated'.
constraints.package_text: V.f: rocks must be <11 cm high; cumulative fractional area covered by rocks < 5% (<5% rock abundance). Not marked TBD.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

constraints.note: Not applied to Earth sites: Earth has only the ATI proxy (K⁻¹), a different variable and unit from thermal inertia (J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½).
constraints.package_text: V.g: thermal inertia must be >100 J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½, preferably >150. Not marked TBD.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

constraints.note: Landing ellipse size. Not an Earth filter.
constraints.package_text: V.c: ellipse 100 × 25 km, long axis oriented 330°–350° clockwise from north. Not marked TBD.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

constraints.note: Ground-penetrating radar depth range. Used as the ice-depth target, not as a filter.
constraints.package_text: Not an engineering constraint in the package. Section IV.a says the GPR is expected to reach ~3–5 m of subsurface penetration in low-loss materials, which CONFLICTS with the team value 0.5–3 m. Team to decide which range to use; the team value is kept unchanged for now.
constraints.checked: Checked by the assistant against the SkyFall Mission Information Package (section V) on 2026-11-11; still VERIFY until a second team member checks it.

missions.constraints_note: tbd_by_nasa now follows the SkyFall Mission Information Package (Sep 2026): the 100 m slope limit and the southern latitude limit are TBD; elevation, rock cover, thermal inertia and ellipse are not. The GPR depth is not a constraint in the package.
